# Faceless Champ

> Python 3.12+ video authoring library. Manim-style scenes, Pillow frames, FFmpeg MP4.

- [Quickstart](README.md)
- [API](docs/api.md)
- [Timing, composition, audio, troubleshooting](docs/guide.md)
- [Renderer and timeline architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [Runnable examples](examples/showcase.py)
- [Authoring skill](skills/faceless-champ/SKILL.md)

Import from faceless_champ. Subclass Scene and override construct(). Use add(),
play(), wait(), and add_audio(). Coordinates are design pixels, top-left origin,
positive Y down; component anchors default to center. play() advances time and runs
its arguments concurrently. Audio start defaults to the current cursor, not zero.
Export with render() or faceless-champ render file.py SceneName -o output.mp4.
Use Sequence for cuts/crossfades and Grid for simultaneous row-major panels.
No camera, charts, subtitle system, video import, or graphical editor in v0.1.
